story: ActionSA’s Nasiphi Moya was re-elected mayor of Tshwane on Thursday after a coalition including the ANC, the EFF and the MK Party backed her over the DA’s Cilliers Brink.
Authorities opened a sluice gate at the Vaal Dam after heavy rain pushed it above full capacity, while Gauteng and Mpumalanga cleaned up from flash floods that damaged homes and roads.
South Africa welcomed more than one million international tourists in October, about 10 percent more than a year earlier, and is on track to beat last year’s record.
Snow reached the Swiss lowlands on Thursday for the first time this winter, while high Alpine valleys recorded their deepest November snow since 1987.

Switzerland’s government confirmed that from January 2027 pregnant women will no longer pay health-insurance deductibles or co-payments from the start of pregnancy, rather than only from the 13th week.
